findings.info: Na Hroudě - Staré Strašnice: OSM maps grass over the track for 198 m (s 16652-16850), and nothing we know says so. Is the track grassed here? The pins are where OSM's grass starts and ends; grass track stops at platforms, crossings and junctions by itself.
